notes: Original volumetric (Micromeritics HPVA) excess H2 isotherms at 77 K and 298 K up to 50 bar on six sucrose-derived ordered mesoporous carbons (C 89.1-94.5 wt %, Table 2); BET areas 787-1168 m2/g (Table 2) for the same samples. Eng. 2018) covers NCCR-41 and CMK-3 hydrogen sorption, but this paper does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before, and four of the six carbons are not in that title, so duplicate_data is not applied.
